C1083.title: Recruiting for Forex 'Trading' Unravels a Billion-Yuan Pyramid Scheme
C1083.summary: In November 2019, defendant Song was introduced to the 'TR Forex' platform by an online acquaintance. Disguised as foreign exchange trading, the platform lured participants to recruit downline members with promises of high returns. Song actively enlisted relatives, friends, and netizens, accumulating 4,045 subordinate accounts with involved funds exceeding 140 million yuan. The court convicted him

references.title: Recruiting people for forex 'trading' unravels a billion-yuan pyramid scheme - Prosecution - Jiangxi Political and Legal Network
